traits.name: fierce
traits.reason: Lines say 'Build hard!' but no one crosses her and no sharp retorts or mending after damage appear.

traits.name: loyal
traits.reason: Gives directions ('East six', 'Bridges south. Come.'), builds bridges and roads, and calls to Stoutheart and Lagalong to come.

traits.name: jealous
traits.reason: Repeated clipped lines about Lagalong leaving and 'Jealous light tonight!', with 'Build harder' when Lagalong is away.

traits.name: vain
traits.reason: Announces her roads and bridges with some pleasure, but no pretended nonchalance about discoveries.

traits.name: chime like
traits.reason: Short bursts with headings and counts and exclamations, though some lines run past eight words and name peers.
